subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate collocation to fill in the blank.

I was running late so I only had time for a ___________ shower.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quick**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**quick**" is most appropriate for describing a short and hurried shower.
 
• The other options: "**relaxed**," "**luxurious**," and "**long**" do not match the context of being late.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I was running late so I only had time for a quick__ shower.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Relaxed**: means calm and leisurely, which doesn't fit the urgency described.
 
• **Luxurious**: means very elegant or involving great comfort, which contradicts the time constraint.
 
• **Long**: means extended duration, which is not possible when running late.
